name: Amol Pawar
player_statement:
A complete player, Amol Pawar has made a big mark in cricket. With 36 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 66*, with an average of 35.04 and a quick strike rate of 175.20. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 81 sixes and 44 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 59.4 overs, taking 36 wickets at an economy rate of 6.37. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
